subject.title: fix: keep LINE group allowlists scoped [AI]

question: Should the fail-closed LINE group boundary land after live proof with explicit upgrade guidance, or must an in-product diagnostic for formerly fallback-dependent configurations be added first?
rationale: Removing the fallback fixes a concrete authorization inconsistency but can intentionally stop existing group workflows, so maintainers must own the security-versus-upgrade handling and release inclusion.

options.title: Land with proof and upgrade guidance
options.body: Rebase, provide a redacted real LINE authorization run, and document that formerly implicit group senders now require explicit group allowlist entries.

options.title: Require a diagnostic first
options.body: Add a doctor or security-audit warning for LINE group allowlist configurations that have no effective group entries before landing the fail-closed change.

recommendation.title: Land with proof and upgrade guidance
recommendation.body: Rebase, provide a redacted real LINE authorization run, and document that formerly implicit group senders now require explicit group allowlist entries.

likelyOwner.reason: They synthesized and merged the prior strict LINE authorization-boundary work that this PR extends.
